record.question: The continued functions of Courts and Tribunals in the State of Mizoram, established under Section 45 of The State of Mizoram Act,1986 are explicitly terminated if they are inconsistent with the Act or if:
options: the appropriate Government fails to make adaptations within two years.
their expenditure is not authorised by the Governor within 6 months.
the Central Government exercises its power to remove difficulties under Section 47.
other provision is made by a competent Legislator or other authority
